notes.title: V0.7.5 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Based on your feedback, we have conducted an optimization of the current version. The key improvements are as follows:

Added a 2x speed feature, allowing NPCs to move more swiftly.
Adjusted the movement mechanics of talismans. Now, the movable range is displayed only upon selecting a talisman.
Fixed several known bugs, enhancing game stability and smoothness.
We value your opinions and suggestions greatly. Please feel free to provide feedback through our forum or Q-group. We are eager to hear from you and continuously improve the gaming experience.

Thank you once again for your support and participation!

Wishing you an enjoyable gaming experience!

Best regards,
Game Development Team
